title: Elliptic-billiard invariant k_{702}
exact_target: For periods greater than four, prove that the signed area of the outer polygon divided by that of its evolute polygon stays constant.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5100040 (AMR-050-0040). CC BY 4.0.
Dan Reznik, Ronaldo Garcia and Jair Koiller, \emph{Eighty New Invariants in the Elliptic Billiard}, arXiv:2004.12497v11 (29 October 2020), \S3.8 and Table 8, pp. 8--9.
